items.title: Norris Turney interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: I left there and went to St. Louis when I joined the Jeter Pillars Orchestra.

ctx.x: It was like time to leave home and go out?
Yeah, well, I’d been working at the Cotton Club for maybe a year or so, and I left there and went to St. Louis when I joined the Jeter Pillars Orchestra. You ever heard of them?
